note: Jefferson County, Idaho publishes its zoning as a PDF zone map (2008, amended 2010) and Rigby's zone map is a static PDF. The county's zoning viewer (jeffgis ArcGIS Online app) has no public item data, and the county's ArcGIS server (grant.co.jefferson.id.us) was unreachable from my tools. The zoning services I found belong to other counties (Jefferson County WA and CO, Alaska layer), so no queryable Idaho Jefferson County zoning polygons were found.
